ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students with freshmen standing. Lab hours include assisting in preschool classroom 4 hours per week, including lesson planning and implementation, guidance practice, and guided experience with portfolio informal assessment tool. There will be important weekly individual meetings set up with lab instructor once classes start. Registration by non-HDFS majors requires instructor permission. Contact Dr. Brent McBride at brentmcb@illinois.edu or Dr. Linlin Yao at lyao@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Human Development & Family St major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
